claims.text: Limited-stage: abbreviated ABVD (doxorubicin, bleomycin, vinblastine, dacarbazine) ± radiation.
claims.quote: Limited-stage disease is generally treated with an abbreviated chemotherapy regimen of doxorubicin (Adriamycin), bleomycin, vinblastine, and dacarbazine (ABVD) with or without radiation therapy

claims.text: Advanced: options incl ABVD, AVD (⍉bleomycin), BEACOPP, AVD + brentuximab vedotin, AVD + nivolumab (poised to become the new strd).
claims.quote: Reasonable options may include ABVD, AVD (no bleomycin), BEACOPP (bleomycin, etoposide, doxorubicin, cyclophosphamide, vincristine, procarbazine, and prednisone), AVD plus brentuximab vedotin, and AVD plus nivolumab, which is poised to become the new standard of care

claims.text: Brentuximab vedotin (Adcetris): untx stage III or IV classical HL w doxorubicin, vinblastine, dacarbazine.
claims.quote: previously untreated Stage III or IV classical Hodgkin lymphoma (cHL), in combination with doxorubicin, vinblastine, and dacarbazine
